content.introduction: The US markets experienced a 1.09% gain with technology stocks rising and energy stocks falling, according to the weekly market update. The valuation barometers show declines in large and small market sectors, with mid-cap sectors seeing a slight increase. Earnings reports include Zscaler falling 5% post-earnings, Adobe facing pressure from its freemium transition, Oracle making progress toward long-term revenue goals, Broadcom experiencing a 3% drop despite high AI chip demand, Macy's showing improvement despite near-term uncertainty, and Snowflake rising 10% on strong earnings growth.
